clue.text: Musical stored inside piano roll's top container?

indicators.note: the musical is placed within the two letters that follow, as goods are stored in a box

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter, here the first of roll's

parts.note: Annie is the stage musical about a Depression-era orphan

explanation.surface: A show tune is tucked inside the roll of a player piano, which is jokingly called a container.
explanation.walkthrough: ANNIE goes between P and R, the first letter of roll's.
explanation.definitionFit: A pannier is a basket or bag slung over a bicycle or pack animal for carrying goods.

clue.text: Article on site associated with Apollo Theatre

parts.note: A is the indefinite article
Delphi in Greece was the site of Apollo's famous oracle

explanation.surface: Something about a location linked to the Apollo Theatre in London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Apollo Theatre' reads as one name, but Apollo is the Greek god and Theatre is the definition: the Adelphi is a theatre on the Strand in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The Adelphi is a well-known West End playhouse in London, an example of a theatre.

clue.text: Certainly no opening for kidnap

indicators.note: the word for kidnap loses its opening letter

parts.note: to snatch someone is to kidnap them

explanation.surface: An emphatic refusal: certainly there is no chance of a kidnapping.
explanation.walkthrough: SNATCH loses its first letter, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Natch is informal shorthand for naturally, used to mean of course or surely.

clue.text: Et ceteras Jo removed could have her off the aircraft pdq

definitions.text: could have her off the aircraft pdq

indicators.note: the letters are moved out of their places and rearranged, taken as an anagram signal

explanation.surface: Jo, with all the odds and ends removed, could be thrown off the plane very quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: ETCETERAS and JO rearrange to give the eleven letters. pdq is slang for pretty damn quick.
explanation.definitionFit: An ejector seat fires a pilot clear of a stricken aircraft in an instant, so it could get her out quickly.

clue.text: Name taken by game master

indicators.note: the letter for name is taken into the game, held inside it

parts.note: hockey is a game played with sticks

explanation.surface: A name is adopted by a champion of some game.
explanation.walkthrough: N goes inside HOCKEY. 'Game master' suggests a quizmaster or games champion, but master means a great artist here.
explanation.definitionFit: David Hockney is a celebrated British painter, an old master in the making; master means a great artist.

clue.text: They might hum, unsmiling, in Old Style setting

indicators.note: the word for unsmiling goes in the abbreviation that follows
Old Style acts as a setting, holding the word for unsmiling as a mount holds a stone

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for style here, OS being Old Style for dates
dour means stern and unsmiling

explanation.surface: Grim-faced people singing to themselves in an old-fashioned setting.
explanation.walkthrough: DOUR goes inside OS. To hum is British slang for to smell bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Smells are what might hum, in the British slang sense of giving off a bad whiff.

clue.text: Jokes about grand passion for soft treatment aids

indicators.note: the word for jokes goes round the other pieces

parts.note: kids, as a verb, means teases or jokes
G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds
love is passion

explanation.surface: Humour about great passion as a way of treating someone gently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jokes' looks like a noun, but it is the verb meaning teases. G for grand is slang for a thousand pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Treating someone with kid gloves means handling them gently, so the gloves are aids to tactful handling.

clue.text: Rocky area is uranium-enriched vast tract

indicators.note: the anagram is enriched by having the uranium symbol added to it
rocky means unsteady, so the letters of area is wobble into a new order

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A rugged region rich in uranium spreads across a huge landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rocky' makes the anagram and 'enriched' slips the uranium symbol inside the result, just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Eurasia is the combined landmass of Europe and Asia, the largest continuous expanse of land on Earth.

clue.text: Famous 5 article getting more column inches?

parts.note: A is the indefinite article
a story given more newspaper space makes ...

explanation.surface: A news story about the Famous Five getting extra coverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Famous 5' suggests Enid Blyton's children's adventure series, but 5 is the answer at 5-across, the painter HOCKNEY, and this is his famous painting.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bigger Splash is the celebrated 1967 swimming-pool painting by the artist at 5-across.

clue.text: See 4
Art of sewer decoration?

parts.note: sewer is read as one who sews, not a drain, so this is decorative needlework

explanation.surface: A dubious art form: decorating the drains.
explanation.walkthrough: Sewer means a person sewing, not a waste pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornamental needlework is the decorative craft practised by someone with needle and thread.

clue.text: It happened in the end lift crack

parts.note: to lift is to raise up
a crack or a shot is an attempt

explanation.surface: The lift finally broke and cracked.
explanation.definitionFit: The final result or outcome of events is what happened in the end.

clue.text: Leave empty room smaller than before, not having a clue

parts.note: to go is to leave

indicators.note: an emptied word keeps only its outer letters

parts.note: less means reduced in amount

explanation.surface: Clearing out a room so it is smaller than it was, without any idea why.
explanation.definitionFit: Gormless is British informal for stupid or clueless.

clue.text: Bids under, breaking free

indicators.note: breaking the words apart lets the letters re-form in a new order

explanation.surface: Low offers at auction, breaking free.
explanation.definitionFit: To disburden is to relieve of a load, so to set free from a burden.

clue.text: Corporation founder's shambolic board manoeuvre?

parts.note: corporation is old humorous slang for a paunch or belly
to founder is to fail or flop; the 's is read as is

explanation.surface: The head of a company makes a messy boardroom move.
explanation.walkthrough: Board means a diving board, not a company board. Corporation as slang for a potbelly is dated British humour.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy dive landing flat on the stomach is a messy diving-board move.

clue.text: About those taking flight 161

parts.note: read as 1, 6, 1: one is A, six in Roman numerals is VI, and one is also AN
read as 1, 6, 1: one is A, six in Roman numerals is VI, and one is also AN
read as 1, 6, 1: one is A, six in Roman numerals is VI, and one is also AN

explanation.surface: A note about passengers on flight number 161.
explanation.walkthrough: The three-digit flight number is read one digit at a time; 1 can stand for either form of the indefinite article.
explanation.definitionFit: Avian means relating to birds, the creatures that take to the air.

clue.text: Burn peeled off in layers with no end of heartache

indicators.note: the word for peeled off loses the letter that follows

parts.note: skin or paint that scaled came away in flakes

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A burn whose skin is flaking off, with heartache never ending.
explanation.walkthrough: SCALED loses E, the last letter of heartache.
explanation.definitionFit: A scald is an injury to the skin from hot liquid or steam, a type of burn.

clue.text: Writer's block — in bed before start of evening

indicators.note: the word for block sits inside the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a let is an obstruction, as in without let or hindrance

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An author suffering writer's block lies in bed until the evening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writer's block' looks like the fixed phrase, but the 's means is and block is a separate piece of wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Colette was the French novelist who wrote Gigi, so she is a writer.

clue.text: Escort's state? Unserviceable — the woman's cool

parts.note: US is a crossword abbreviation for unserviceable or useless
hers means belonging to the woman
hip means fashionable or cool

explanation.surface: A report that a hired escort is useless while the woman stays calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Ushership is the office or position of a person who escorts people to their seats.

clue.text: Creature's energy, life force and cycles

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
chi is the Chinese term for vital energy

indicators.note: the word and cycles back round on itself, so it is read in the opposite direction

explanation.surface: An animal's strength, vitality and rhythms of life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and cycles' looks like a joining phrase, but 'cycles' is the indicator that turns the little word round.
explanation.definitionFit: The echidna is a spiny egg-laying mammal of Australia and New Guinea, an example of an animal.

clue.text: Pushed to do something unprepared and so likely to go under?

definitions.text: Pushed to do something unprepared and so likely to go under?

parts.words: Pushed to do something unprepared and so likely to go under?
parts.note: the idiom for being thrown into a task without preparation, read literally as a swimmer thrown where they cannot touch the bottom

explanation.surface: Someone forced into a job with no training is likely to fail.
explanation.walkthrough: Go under is both to fail and to sink in water.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means facing a hard task with no preparation, like a non-swimmer thrown into deep water.

clue.text: Unknown metal containing cold mineral

parts.note: Z is one of the letters used for unknown quantities in algebra

indicators.note: the word for metal holds the abbreviation for cold within it

parts.note: iron is a metal
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: An unidentified metal with a cold mineral inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Zircon is a silicate mineral, sometimes cut as a gemstone.

clue.text: List of the actors etc to take the role of Sykes?

parts.note: to play a part is to take the role
Bill Sikes, often spelt Sykes, is the villain of Dickens's Oliver Twist

explanation.surface: Casting an actor as the Dickens villain, and listing the company.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre poster or programme announcing a play and its cast lists the performers.

clue.text: In irritation, say, 4 x 4 almost knocked over horseman

indicators.note: the whole assembly is knocked over, so it reads from the bottom up in this down-style reversal
the shortened vehicle goes in the word for irritation

parts.note: a rash is an example of skin irritation

indicators.note: almost means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a 4 x 4 is a four-wheel-drive vehicle, an SUV or sport utility vehicle

explanation.surface: Irritated, an off-road vehicle nearly runs down a rider.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' puts the shortened vehicle inside the irritation, giving RASSUH, and 'knocked over' turns that whole run backwards. A 4 x 4 is a four-wheel-drive car.
explanation.definitionFit: A hussar was a soldier of the light cavalry, so a mounted fighting man.

clue.text: Clog junk boats

indicators.note: junk as a verb means to scrap, so the word boats is broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Junks are boats that clog the harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: Junk looks like the Chinese sailing ship beside boats, but it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A sabot is a wooden shoe carved from a single block, a kind of clog.

clue.text: Idealistic rocks given a stressed look

indicators.note: rocks means shakes, so the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: An idealist is rattled and looks stressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Slanted type is used to give emphasis, so text set this way is given a stressed look.

clue.text: Standby terraced housing bits combined

indicators.note: the words house the answer within them, across the join between them

explanation.surface: A spare terraced house made up of combined parts.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing, a unit of eight binary digits taken together forms a single storage unit.

clue.text: See 21
Jail youth's liquid holder

parts.note: can is US slang for prison
a teen is a youth; the 's is read as is

explanation.surface: A young offender's water bottle in prison.
explanation.definitionFit: A canteen is a flask for carrying water or drink, as carried by soldiers or campers.
